Fixed. The bug was in `lib/fluent/event_router.rb:388`: when an output plugin raised an error (e.g., `BufferOverflowError`), `emit_stream`'s rescue passed the **original** event stream `es` to `handle_emits_error` instead of `processed` — the stream that has gone through the filter chain. The record forwarded to the `@ERROR` label therefore lacked modifications from filters.

Changed the rescue to `@emit_error_handler.handle_emits_error(tag, processed, e)`. Verified:
- `test/test_event_router.rb` — 23 tests pass (including `can pass records modified by filters to handle_emits_error`, which was failing)
- `test/test_root_agent.rb`, `test/plugin/test_filter.rb`, `test/plugin/test_filter_record_transformer.rb` — all pass
